```
def load_unverified_project_from_config(project_root: Path
    ) ->UnverifiedProjectModel:
    project_path = project_root / PROJECT_CONFIG
    config = configparser.ConfigParser()
    config.read(project_path)

    id = None
    url_path = None
    name = None

    if PROJECT_CONFIG_SECTION in config.sections():
        id = config[PROJECT_CONFIG_SECTION].get(PROJECT_CONFIG_ID, None)
        url_path = config[PROJECT_CONFIG_SECTION].get(PROJECT_CONFIG_URL, None)
        name = config[PROJECT_CONFIG_SECTION].get(PROJECT_CONFIG_NAME, None)

    return UnverifiedProjectModel(id=id, url_path=url_path, name=name,
                                  project_path=project_path)
```

```
def process_files(paths: Dict[str, Set[Path]], config: Optional[ConfigModel
    ]=None) ->Generator[Tuple[Path, InspectableFile], None, None]:
    for file_type, file_paths in paths.items():
        for path in file_paths:
            try:
                with InspectableFileContext(path, file_type=file_type) as inspectable_file:
                    if inspectable_file:
                        yield path, inspectable_file
            except Exception as e:
                LOG.error(f"Error processing file {path}: {e}", exc_info=True)
```
